mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in the past month signals a loosening of monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the past two months indicates weakening labor market conditions, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter signals strengthening economic demand, which typically boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the quarters where GDPC1 increases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in the past two months indicates a robust supply-side response, which often correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in the past month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in the past two months signals a weakening in the housing market, which often correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in the past month signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 70% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% in the past month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals strong consumer demand and a tightening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
